scope: Public primary research, repository metadata/source/license only. No private challenge data read, attached or uploaded.
freshness_policy: Pinned latest reachable default-branch commit returned by GitHub API with until=2026-11-15T23:59:59Z. Release dates are publication dates; repo updated_at is not treated as code recency.

sources.title: PathCRF: Ball-Free Soccer Event Detection via Possession Path Inference from Player Trajectories
sources.publication_status: KDD2026 proceedings; journal reference and DOI verified on arXiv
claims_supported: Dynamic observation-conditioned transitions have direct soccer possession-path precedent.
Published inference is restricted to in-play episodes and default5FPS; not a complete dead-play decoder.
GPU latency on RTX4090 cannot establish CPU latency.
limitations: No local reproduction or independent paper-result verification.
No demonstrated transfer to anonymous slots or this challenge label semantics.
Initial Exa abs response mixed full v1 content with v2 metadata; conclusions use explicit html/v2 retrieval.

sources.method: torch DynamicSparseCRF with incoming-edge lists and embedding-based transition scoring
sources.integration: High: identified-player edge states, new neural backbone, labels and preprocessing; take design precedent only initially.
sources.cpu_memory: No measured CPU evidence. Sparse implementation avoids naive dense transition storage, but edge embeddings/temporal attention and hundreds of states materially exceed3states. Paper's24GBGPU is hardware capacity, not measured peak memory.
claims_supported: Repository imports torch in model source but inspected requirements.txt omits torch.
README supplies code/checkpoints and Sportec preprocessing instructions.
limitations: No dependency install, weights execution or trained checkpoint reuse.
No latest release endpoint found; null release is not proof no tag exists.

sources.title: Alleviating Over-Segmentation Errors by Detecting Action Boundaries
claims_supported: Separate boundary branch can refine frame segmentation in generic action datasets.
Paper acknowledges low boundary precision and boundary ambiguity.
Experiments use activity/video feature datasets, not soccer tracking.
limitations: No soccer transfer evidence, no CPU measurement in this study.

sources.integration: High for wholesale model; low for boundary/classification separation concept.
limitations: A guessed yonseivnl/asrf URL404ed; corrected official yiskw713/asrf is named in primary paper.

sources.title: Selective review of offline change point detection methods
claims_supported: Change-point models combine cost/search/penalty; generic regime changes require an application-specific cost.
The review is linked to the ruptures implementation.
limitations: Not soccer-specific; not evidence for team-control boundary classification.

sources.method: Offline penalized segmentation, pruning optimal search under selected cost; conditional average runtime.
sources.integration: Optional development baseline on compact finite channels; extra runtime dependency not recommended.
claims_supported: Pelt defaults min_size2,jump5 restrict allowed boundaries.
Current Python implementation maintains partition dictionaries; do not assume its memory matches existing3N numeric backpointers.
limitations: Regime changes are not typed possession changes.

sources.method: Unsupervised hidden semi-Markov models with explicit duration distributions; wrapsC++Rhsmm code.
sources.integration: Reject production dependency for initial candidate: archived, compiled toolchain and copyleft obligations.
claims_supported: Explicit durations rather than constant Markov transition costs.
limitations: O(NK²Dmax) in research is generic bounded-duration DP analysis, not a measured hsmmlearn guarantee.

sources.method: Individual possession gains combine proximity duration and speed/direction change; team-possession docs use successful on-ball events.
sources.integration: Candidate physics features/comparator only; no inference-event requirement may enter our model.
limitations: Documentation explicitly warns notebook may lag package.
Observed pinned individual code is stronger evidence for its rules than prose; team-event semantics are documentation evidence, not audited implementation execution.

sources.title: Automatic event detection in football using tracking data
retrieval: official arXiv version history via web
claims_supported: Rule-based individual ball-control extraction is a relevant soccer precedent.
Some evaluation datasets supply in-play status or encode dead play in missing ball; challenge missingness cannot inherit that convention.
limitations: Paper event detection rates are not our H/A/D spellF1; no transfer score claimed.
Original supplied study datasets not accessed.

sources.title: A Semi-Markov framework for modeling football possessions and temporal expected threat
sources.method: Event/action/zone-conditioned sojourn durations and temporal expected threat.
claims_supported: Latest2026 duration research is not necessarily a tracking-possession decoder; this predicts scoring value from observed events.
sources.code_status: Not evaluated/pinned because excluded target; do not treat as reuse-ready repository.

claims: FeatureSet has anonymous team aggregates, not identified trajectories.
pipeline builds constant3x3cost; decoder has exact objective and deterministic tie rules.
Existing features already contain centered proximity/missingness context and teleport guard; noisev2 adds gap-safe1.2s local-linear speed.
Official source headline uses spellF1mean over0.3..0.7IoUs and typed transition tolerances12/25frames.

hypotheses_not_results: Small typed boundary head improves official external spell and transition metrics.
Two float32boundary channels can preserve O(9N) decoder asymptotics with bounded overhead.
Reliability gating avoids tracking-error-induced false switches.
Proposed20%inference and32MiBmemory budgets are review targets, not measurements.
verification_gaps: No local package installation, training or performance benchmarking in research phase.
No private or fresh holdout data accessed.
Independent blind research critique pending; root owns next gate.
